estimates.assumptions: 2 large aubergines ≈ 900 g total raw edible flesh; standard raw aubergine values (4 g carbs, 2 g fiber per 100 g).
2 tbsp olive oil = 28 g; pure oil has zero carbohydrates.
250 g full-fat Greek yogurt; standard values ≈ 4 g carbs per 100 g (mostly lactose).
3 tbsp tahini paste ≈ 48 g; typical tahini values ≈ 18-21 g carbs per 100 g with fiber.
1 small crushed garlic clove ≈ 3 g; standard garlic carbs.
Juice of 1 medium lemon ≈ 45 g; standard lemon juice carbs (mostly sugars).
Handful fresh coriander ≈ 15 g; standard fresh herb values.
Handful fresh parsley ≈ 15 g; standard fresh herb values.
Handful fresh mint ≈ 15 g; standard fresh herb values.
